batch: C03c.1 bias-dependent charge, weak-charge event row repair, and mandatory C03c.2/C03d failures
current_source_hash_scope: Hashes below identify the committed source_revision checkout; historical development runs retain their separate source-state descriptions. Plan/evidence documentation is uncommitted while capturing this record.

independent_reference.use: Analytical GP transport, bias-dependent TF and reverse TR charge formulas plus the separate ngspice Weil recurrence. No live simulator execution is claimed for this batch.

coverage.charge: New 72 public runs across exact/Weil, three dialects, NPN/PNP, saturation/reverse-active/high injection and two timestep sizes, in addition to the prior 54 prescribed-terminal runs.
coverage.physical_current_gate: Fine-grid maximum error < 1e-14 A + 0.02 * peak reference current; fine error < 1e-14 A + 0.7 * coarse error.
coverage.conservation_gate: Existing unmodulated cases retain 1e-14 A + 1e-9 * sum(abs(lead currents)). Added biased charge cases include 256 * epsilon * 2/dt times the independently computed charge-Jacobian/voltage row norm. This accounts for companion subtraction conditioning, not extra physical-current error.
coverage.event_row_fix: Highest-incidence representative in floating charge components preserves a small peripheral Q row; stable node-ID tie break. Unit test covers all six orderings of a three-node star with 1e-9 F and 1e-30 F, common-mode rate 1 and zero differential rate. This is not a universally optimal basis for arbitrary charge graphs.
coverage.checkpoint_identity: v98 after numerical event-equation row-selection change.

required_failures.outcome: Ngspice NPN constant high-injection bias: convergence failure after 15 iterations with RELTOL=1e-7.
required_failures.gate: All three dialects and both polarities maintain independent lead currents within 1e-12 A + 1e-5 * abs(reference), to 2.5 ns. Remove ignore only after this passes.

required_failures.outcome: Ngspice NPN high-injection case fails convergence after 374 iterations near 2 ns; preceding saturation/reverse-active cases pass their independent comparisons.
required_failures.gate: Native-source manufactured forcing is independently checked within 1e-12 A. Preserve 2% peak current, 2e-4 V intrinsic-voltage and 0.7 refinement limits, complete all cases, then remove ignore.

required_failures.outcome: The disposition test passes because exact-delay GP refuses the behavioral voltage source during physical-event preparation while ordinary Weil transient executes it.
required_failures.gate: Implement the missing physical-event equations and replace the refusal disposition with independent numerical event/continuation qualification; a passing refusal test does not deliver the feature.

rejected_experiment: A temporary zero-rate candidate accepted solely by residual tolerance did not fix the private cases and was reverted before 50523d8fb. Small absolute current into tiny storage can imply a large physical rate; an eventual stationary OP path needs an explicit valid-state contract.
